entries.sense_en: attractive in a way that makes you want to come closer and look
entries.sense_ko: 마음을 끌어당기는, 자꾸 들여다보고 싶게 만드는

synonyms.nuance: Makes you want to do or have something, often something you should resist.
Draws you in with the promise of pleasure or reward; common for food and displays.
synonyms.example: an enticing smell from the kitchen

synonyms.nuance: Pleasing and delightful, but does not suggest being pulled toward something.

entries.sense_en: a performer who speaks without moving the lips so that a doll seems to talk

synonyms.nuance: Works puppets with strings or hands; does not need to hide that the voice is their own.
Performs magic tricks, not voice tricks.
synonyms.example: a conjurer pulling a coin from your ear

entries.tip_ko: ven-TRIL-o-quist: 강세는 두 번째 음절 -tril- 에 옵니다.

entries.sense_en: something that seems real and close but cannot be reached, like water seen in a desert
entries.sense_ko: 신기루 (가까이 보이지만 닿을 수 없는 것)

synonyms.nuance: A false idea or appearance in general; not limited to something seen in the distance.
Something seen or heard that is not there at all, usually from illness or drugs.
A ghost-like image or an imagined thing; more eerie than a mirage.
synonyms.example: a phantom light in the fog

entries.tip_ko: 프랑스어에서 온 말이라 끝이 '-ahzh'(/ɑʒ/)로 납니다. '미라지'가 아니라 '미라-쥬'에 가깝게.

entries.sense_en: hard to reach or get to; always seeming just out of reach
entries.sense_ko: 닿기 어려운, 늘 손이 미치지 않는 곳에 있는

synonyms.nuance: Cannot be reached at all; inaccessible can also mean only hard to reach.
synonyms.example: The village is unreachable in winter.

synonyms.nuance: Far away from other places; says nothing about whether you can actually get there.
Spoken and flexible; works for both places and goals.
synonyms.example: The top shelf is out of reach.

entries.sense_en: pulled or carried something along with effort, as if it were heavy

synonyms.nuance: Pull along the ground, often unwillingly; lug suggests a heavy load carried or hauled.
synonyms.example: drag a chair across the floor

synonyms.nuance: Move something heavy with force over a distance; more purposeful and stronger than lug.
Pull behind you with a rope or vehicle; playful when used for a child.
synonyms.example: tow a sled up the hill

entries.sense_en: a bright, glowing happiness that shows on a person's face

synonyms.nuance: Softer and warmer; often used for a healthy or happy look on the skin.
Plain word for light or a cheerful look; lacks the sense of shining outward.
A wide, happy smile itself rather than the general shine of a face.

entries.sense_en: the main load or responsibility; here, the job of doing most of the talking
entries.sense_ko: 짐, 부담 (여기서는 대화를 이끌어 갈 몫)

synonyms.nuance: The normal modern spelling of the same word; burthen is old-fashioned.
A duty that belongs to you; less heavy and negative than a burden.
Everyday word for something carried; in speech also a workload.

entries.sense_en: sounding sad and a little complaining, like a soft cry

synonyms.nuance: Full of grief, as if for a death or a great loss; heavier than plaintive.
Sad because of longing for something past or out of reach; quieter and dreamy.
Annoying, childish complaining; negative, while plaintive draws sympathy.

entries.sense_en: having a yellowish, unhealthy-looking skin colour

synonyms.nuance: Lacking colour in general; not specifically yellow.
Whitish and dull, like dough; suggests too little sun or bad health.
Yellow because of illness, especially of the liver; a medical term.

entries.sense_en: clever tricks done with the hands, as by a magician

synonyms.nuance: The everyday phrase for the same skill; used for both magic and sneaky tricks.
synonyms.example: a card trick using sleight of hand

synonyms.nuance: The art of doing magic tricks in general, not only with the hands.
Deceiving people, often dishonestly; not a stage art.

entries.tip_ko: 프랑스어 기원으로, 가운데 -de-는 약하게 /də/로 읽고 강세는 마지막 -main에 옵니다: '레저더메인'.

entries.sense_en: a careful, close look at something to understand it

synonyms.nuance: A formal, official check of something, often against a standard.
A long fixed look, often rude; not necessarily thoughtful.
A careful study to find facts, in science or medicine as well as everyday life.

entries.sense_en: in a wise, thoughtful way, as if understanding everything

synonyms.nuance: Ordinary word for acting with good judgment; sagely also suggests a serious, knowing air.
Shows you understand a hidden meaning; can be a little smug.
Seriously, with a solemn face; does not imply wisdom.

entries.sense_en: made himself brave and ready for something frightening or uncertain

synonyms.nuance: Get ready for something unpleasant that you know is coming.
Make yourself hard and firm against fear or feeling; stronger than nerve.
synonyms.example: She steeled herself to say goodbye.

synonyms.nuance: Casual and modern; build energy before a challenge.
synonyms.example: psych yourself up for the test

entries.sense_en: a friendly, easy manner that makes people feel welcome

synonyms.nuance: Plain, warm word for being kind to others; less polished than affability.
Cheerful, hearty good humour, often in a host or older man.
synonyms.example: the geniality of the old innkeeper

synonyms.nuance: Sincere kindness that comes from feeling, not just good manners.

entries.sense_en: not showing any fear or surprise; staying calm and firm
entries.sense_ko: 움찔하지 않는, 겁내거나 놀란 기색 없는

synonyms.nuance: Calm and not shaking; a general everyday word.
Truly without fear; unflinching only means you do not show it.
Accepts pain or trouble without complaint; suggests long-term self-control.

entries.sense_en: fixed and not moving or changing; keeping firmly on one thing

synonyms.nuance: Neutral: not moving. Steadfast adds a sense of determination.
Never shaking or doubting; used for beliefs and loyalty as well as looks.
Faithful to a person or cause; steadfast can also describe a look, loyal cannot.

entries.sense_en: unhealthily pale, lacking colour

synonyms.nuance: The everyday word; can be natural or from fear or illness.
Grey-white, from shock or fear; more dramatic than pale.
Pale and tired-looking, often from illness or sadness; literary.

entries.sense_en: showing no pity when trying to get what one wants

synonyms.nuance: Refusing to spare someone; focuses on how one treats a victim.
Enjoys or does not mind causing pain; ruthless is about single-minded goals.
Lacking kindness or feeling; a more emotional, everyday word.

entries.sense_en: a selfish person who thinks only of themselves and their own wants

synonyms.nuance: Close in meaning; egoist can be someone who acts only for self-interest, egotist mostly boasts.
Obsessed with one's own image; also a psychological term.
Casual; one who displays skills to win attention.

entries.sense_en: with quick, skilful movements of the hands

synonyms.nuance: Quick and neat with the hands; almost the same, slightly more common.
General for any expert action, not only hand movements.
Light and quick on the feet or fingers; stresses lightness.

entries.sense_en: the outward appearance of something, which may hide what is really inside

synonyms.nuance: Neutral word for how something looks.
A front put up to hide the truth; more clearly false.
A false or disguised form used for a purpose.
synonyms.example: in the guise of a friend

entries.sense_en: a person who looks good on the outside but is bad or rotten inside
entries.sense_ko: 겉은 깨끗하나 속은 썩은 사람, 위선자

synonyms.nuance: Says one thing and does another; the everyday word for such a person.
Someone harmful pretending to be harmless.
synonyms.example: He was a wolf in sheep's clothing.

synonyms.nuance: Casual; a fake person or thing, not necessarily evil inside.

entries.tip_ko: 성경(마태복음)에서 온 표현으로, '회칠한 무덤'이라고 번역됩니다.

entries.sense_en: odd, strange and slightly uncomfortable (old British slang)
entries.sense_ko: 묘하게 이상한, 좀 수상쩍은 (옛 영국 속어)

synonyms.nuance: Odd in a way that draws attention; a mild, slightly formal word.
Modern and casual; can be stronger and more unsettling.
Old-fashioned for strange; today mostly used with another meaning, so avoid it for oddness.

entries.tip_ko: 술 이름 '럼'과 철자가 같지만, 여기서는 '이상한'이라는 뜻의 옛 영국 속어입니다.

entries.sense_en: moved with a loose, clumsy, bouncing walk

synonyms.nuance: A neat jump on one or two feet; lollop is looser and more awkward.
Long, energetic leaps; more powerful and graceful than lollop.
synonyms.example: a deer bounding across the field

synonyms.nuance: A long, easy, relaxed stride, smoother than lollop.
synonyms.example: a dog loping along the beach

entries.sense_en: smooth, polite charm, sometimes hiding a hidden purpose
entries.sense_ko: 세련되고 매끄러운 공손함 (속셈이 있을 수도 있는)

synonyms.nuance: Natural attractiveness in manner; more sincere than suavity.
Casual; can suggest slickness or insincerity.
Refined manners from training or experience.

entries.tip_ko: suave는 '스웨이브'가 아니라 /swɑv/, 즉 '스와브'로 읽습니다.

entries.sense_en: small harmful animals or insects that are hard to control, such as rats and fleas

synonyms.nuance: Any animal or insect that damages crops or homes; the common everyday word.
A biological group (rats, mice); not all rodents are vermin.
Casual for any small insect, harmful or not.

entries.sense_en: a complete set of armour and weapons; here, a play set of them

synonyms.nuance: Protective metal covering worn by a knight; panoply also includes weapons and looks impressive.
Full ceremonial dress and symbols of an office.
A wide, impressive display of things of one kind.

entries.sense_en: impossible to defeat

synonyms.nuance: Common, everyday word, especially in sports and prices.
Cannot be taken over, even by a large force; used for armies, spirit and mountains.
Cannot be broken or destroyed, a matter of material strength.

entries.sense_en: a sudden feeling of doubt or unease

synonyms.nuance: A worry about whether something is wise; mostly plural, more formal.
synonyms.example: I have misgivings about the plan.

synonyms.nuance: General, plain word for being unsure.
A moral hesitation that stops you from acting; about right and wrong.

entries.tip_ko: l은 발음하지 않습니다. '퀄름'이 아니라 '쾀'(/kwɑm/)입니다.

entries.sense_en: skilled at quick tricks with the fingers, like a conjurer (a joking word)
entries.sense_ko: 손재주로 요술을 부리는, 마술사 같은 (익살스러운 표현)

synonyms.nuance: Quick with the hands; can describe a pickpocket or a piano player.
Skilful and neat with the hands; not tied to magic.

entries.tip_ko: 'prestidigitator(마술사)'에서 온 말장난 같은 형용사로, 실제 대화에서는 거의 쓰지 않습니다.

entries.sense_en: confusing in a way that makes you unable to find your way or understand
entries.sense_ko: 당혹스럽게 하는, 갈피를 잡을 수 없게 하는

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for something hard to follow.
So puzzling that you cannot find any answer.
Confusing because there is too much or too much going on at once.

entries.sense_en: not straight; a little turned or tilted to one side

synonyms.nuance: Bent or not straight; often permanent.
Uneven, with one side higher or heavier.
Not in the middle; does not suggest tilting.

entries.tip_ko: 'go askew'는 '틀어지다, 제자리에서 벗어나다'로 자주 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: twisting and curving like a snake

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a road or river with many bends.
Smoothly curving and graceful, often about bodies or lines.
Turning sharply and repeatedly; less graceful.

entries.sense_en: filled completely, as if flooded, with a feeling

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for water or, figuratively, too much of something arriving.
Overwhelm with too much work or too many things; a heavier feeling of being unable to cope.
Too strong or too much for someone to handle, often emotionally.

entries.tip_ko: 'be inundated with ~'(~이 쇄도하다) 형태로 자주 쓰입니다.

entries.sense_en: waved something about in a showy way

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for moving something back and forth.
Wave a weapon or object threateningly or proudly.
Move in a wide arc; no sense of showing off.

entries.tip_ko: '꽃피다, 번창하다'라는 뜻이 더 흔한 단어지만, 여기서는 '휘두르다'입니다.

entries.sense_en: so busy thinking about or doing one thing that you notice nothing else

synonyms.nuance: Deeply and pleasantly interested in something.
Attention pulled away, often by worry; can seem confused.
Completely taken up by an interesting activity.

entries.sense_en: suggesting that something evil or harmful is about to happen

synonyms.nuance: Warns that something bad is coming; about the future.
Threatening, as if someone could hurt you now.
Casual; causes an uneasy shiver, not necessarily danger.

entries.sense_en: escaped from, by being quick or clever

synonyms.nuance: Avoid on purpose, often a duty, a question or the police.
Casual; move quickly aside to avoid a blow or a question.
Get away from a place or danger; general term.

entries.tip_ko: 'The answer eluded me.'처럼 '생각이 나지 않는다'는 뜻으로도 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: not knowing what to do or say

synonyms.nuance: Confused about something you want to understand.
Confused and lost in an unfamiliar situation; more informal.
synonyms.example: I'm completely at sea with this software.

synonyms.nuance: Unable to answer a question or solve a problem.

entries.tip_ko: 'at a loss for words'(말문이 막히다) 형태로 자주 나옵니다.

entries.sense_en: bad-tempered in a childish way, like someone annoyed over a small thing

synonyms.nuance: Silent and moody after being upset.
Easily irritated and complaining; a bit weak and old-fashioned.
Casual for a mood of the moment; milder.

entries.sense_en: mentally upset or unbalanced

synonyms.nuance: Upset or mentally troubled; milder and more clinical.
Seriously insane, often violent.
Casual; made nervous, but only for a short time.
synonyms.example: He seemed rattled after the news.

entries.tip_ko: 문 경첩(hinge)이 빠진 모습에서 온 표현입니다.

entries.sense_en: calm acceptance of pain or disappointment without complaining
entries.sense_ko: 불평 없이 참고 견디는 태도, 극기

synonyms.nuance: Ability to last through hardship; not about showing calm.
Staying calm and in control in a difficult moment.
Accepting something bad because nothing can be done; more passive and sad.

entries.sense_en: not yet certain or final; may change later

synonyms.nuance: Lasting for a limited time.
Not fully sure; often used for plans and steps.
Coming between two periods, formal.

entries.sense_en: far more than is reasonable, especially in time or amount

synonyms.nuance: More than is needed or wanted; general, neutral.
Shocking and unfair, usually about behaviour or prices.
Wrong and impossible to forgive; about morality more than amount.

entries.tip_ko: 원래 '양심에 어긋나는'이라는 뜻이며, 여기서는 과장된 용법으로 '터무니없이 긴'의 의미입니다.

entries.sense_en: without knowing or noticing

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; a person does not realise what they are doing.
Not on purpose; focus on intention, not on awareness.
Suddenly, before someone is ready.

entries.tip_ko: 'catch someone unawares'(~의 허를 찌르다)로 자주 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: showing feeling clearly without words
entries.sense_ko: 말없이도 감정을 분명히 드러내는, 표정으로 말하는

synonyms.nuance: Shows thoughts and feelings clearly; about faces, voices and music.
Able to put ideas into clear words; needs speech.
Reveals the truth, often unintentionally.

entries.tip_ko: 보통은 '말을 잘하는'의 뜻이지만, 여기서는 '눈빛이 말을 대신하는' 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: a secret helper who works with someone in a trick

synonyms.nuance: A helper in a crime; the common word for a partner in wrongdoing.
synonyms.example: The thief and his accomplice ran off.

synonyms.nuance: Legal term for one who helps a crime without being present.
Friendly helper of a hero; not criminal.

entries.sense_en: in a sudden, careless way, without polite manners

synonyms.nuance: Suddenly and without warning; neutral about manners.
Short and rude in speech or manner.
With force; stresses the lack of gentleness, not politeness.

entries.sense_en: brave and determined despite fear or difficulty

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; facing danger or pain without fear.
Brave and noble, often in a losing struggle.
Casual; small but full of spirit.

entries.tip_ko: 'gallant'가 '(남성이 여성에게) 정중한'의 뜻일 때는 /gəˈlænt/로 강세가 뒤에 옵니다.

entries.sense_en: selling goods in large amounts, usually to shops, at lower prices

synonyms.nuance: Large quantity; not tied to who is buying.
Selling to businesses instead of customers, as in trade price.

entries.tip_ko: 반대말은 retail(소매)입니다.

entries.sense_en: free and not holding anything

synonyms.nuance: Plain word; not occupied or held.
Not being used or filled.
Not tied or held tightly.

entries.sense_en: slowly gather in larger and larger amounts over time

synonyms.nuance: Casual and physical; things build up in a heap.
synonyms.example: Dishes pile up in the sink.

synonyms.nuance: Grow gradually; can describe pressure or muscles.
Come together, quickly or slowly; general.

entries.sense_en: annoying; a mild word used to show irritation

synonyms.nuance: Mildly angry, old-fashioned; used before a noun.
Very mild, avoids swearing.
Miserable or very bad; less humorous.

entries.sense_en: knights in old stories who travel about looking for adventures to help people

synonyms.nuance: A medieval soldier of high rank; knight-errant wanders freely.
A modern person who seeks excitement; not tied to chivalry.

entries.sense_en: paid attention to what someone said

synonyms.nuance: Everyday; hear and think about it.
Pay attention and follow, as in a warning.
Become aware of something and react.

entries.tip_ko: 'heed a warning'(경고를 새겨듣다)처럼 주로 조언·경고와 함께 씁니다.
